tools.name: race_paces
tools.description: Use when a runner gives a race result and asks what pace to train at or what they could run over another distance. Needs one distance and finishing time; returns predicted race times and training paces with how each should feel, and stores nothing.

tools.name: plan_to_race
tools.description: Use when someone wants a running training plan toward a race or distance (5k, 10k, half marathon, marathon, ultra), beginners included. Needs the goal, what they run in a normal week and how many days they can run; returns the VERA app's plan shape and rules for you to write the plan, which check_pl

tools.name: check_plan
tools.description: Use when you have written a plan from plan_to_race, before showing it: send the same runner facts and the plan you wrote, in the plan format. tools.name: plan_first_weeks
tools.description: Use when someone wants only the first two weeks of a running plan toward a goal race. Writes them from what the runner runs now: day by day, each session sized with its effort, and a short reason where it helps. tools.name: goal_check
tools.description: Use when a runner asks if a race goal or goal time is realistic. Needs the goal, the weeks to it, what they run now and how many days, and a recent race time if they have one; returns the VERA app's own realism check and predicted time, for you to answer, and stores nothing.

tools.name: race_day
tools.description: Use when a runner asks how to pace, fuel or prepare for a race in the last days or on race day. Needs the race distance and a goal time or recent race; returns the VERA app's race coaching and the pacing numbers, for you to write their race plan, and stores nothing.

tools.name: comeback_plan
tools.description: Use when a runner is coming back after an injury, illness or a break and asks how to restart. Needs their usual week before, the weeks off and why; returns the VERA app's comeback rules and week-by-week km, for you to write the weeks, and stores nothing.

tools.name: strength_session
tools.description: Use when a runner asks for a strength, mobility, Pilates or yoga session or routine. Takes the minutes, focus and equipment; returns the VERA app's strength and mobility rules for runners, for you to write the session, and stores nothing.

tools.name: run_check
tools.description: Use when a runner shares one run (distance, time, maybe heart rate or km splits) and asks how it went or what it means. Returns the VERA app's run-card read against their usual and how even the splits were, for you to answer, and stores nothing.

tools.name: training_check
tools.description: Use when a runner pastes or lists their recent runs and asks how their training is going, for a weekly recap, or if they are on track. Returns the VERA app's own Analytics read (readiness, consistency, balance), for you to write the recap, and stores nothing.

tools.name: hr_zones
tools.description: Use when a runner asks for heart-rate zones or what heart rate to run easy, long, tempo or intervals at. Needs their max heart rate or age; returns the VERA app's heart-rate bands per kind of session, and stores nothing.

tools.name: conditions_pace
tools.description: Use when a runner asks how to adjust pace for heat, humidity, hills or altitude. Needs their normal pace and the conditions; returns how much slower the same effort runs, for you to answer, and stores nothing.
